bias: 'The Inception Box: breaking out doesn't mean escaping.' Both took out Monday's lows overnight (ES also Friday's) and found no acceptance — active LBAF sequences, which are an automatic mental downgrade for subsequent shorts (temper expectations for continuation, don't abandon shorts at resistance). NQ reclaimed 28200-28233 overnight and reached exactly 28443.5 (the 28444-28485 daily); ES reclaimed 7591-7594 and 7600, and 7618-7623 rejected twice — but neither retested its RTH low. Sellers had a chance to press a weakened market and couldn't; bulls haven't objectively accomplished anything either. Value is gapping lower this week for both; ES is trapped below 7618-7623, NQ below 28444-28485. He is not forcing a directional opinion — let the auction tell us.
wildcard: Election results overnight — sharp two-way moves; a substantial excursion beyond Tuesday's range in either direction can return to the box, and a break alone doesn't resolve it. Only executing at the EDGES of Tuesday's RTH range — not the middle. Favored: long a LBAF of Tuesday's low, short a LAAF of Tuesday's high; cautious initiating longs on an upside breakout given the bearish context. Bull HTF note: ES has an active (ETH) LBAF of the 3-month balance — would carry more weight in RTH with 7541-7543 properly tagged; NQ held the 200-day / YTD VWAP / Jan-high AVWAP cluster with an active LBAF of last week's and Monday's lows. AMD reported after the close; NQ nearly back to 444-485. Daily: ES 7738-7741, 7662; NQ 29194-29220, 28608-28639, 28444-28485 (LAAF monitor).
